about: police_system radio_voice database, generated by tools/build_db.py - do not edit by hand

varsHelp.plate: plate text -> CHAR.* one by one (spaces / dashes skipped, max 8)
varsHelp.vehicle: model id -> maps.vehicles (no entry: the item is dropped)
varsHelp.direction: heading in degrees (0 = north, counter-clockwise like GTA rotZ) -> DIR.HEADING.*
varsHelp.crime: scene category / wanted reason -> maps.sceneCrime / maps.reasonCrime
varsHelp.area: getZoneName -> AREA.* (no audio yet: always dropped, with the item before it when that is a CONJ)

audiences.officer: only the officer who pressed / queried
audiences.chase: the members of every unit in the chase (CH.join)
audiences.onduty: every on-duty officer (POL.units.onDuty) - later: only within the radio zone / channel

ACK.hook: RD.handle: every radio id that worked and has no phrase of its own
ACK.note: no officer voice: the key-up click then 'Copy.'

QUERY_VEHICLE.args: stolen = r.stolen, warrant = r.ownerWarrants > 0, violation = registration/inspection expired, caution = stolen or warrant, felony = stolen and warrant

QUERY_PERSON.args: warrant = r.warrants > 0, licence = r.licence ~= 'valid', wanted = r.wanted > 0

CALL_OFFER.hook: callouts: a new offer popup of a unit (POL.emit callout.offered)
CALL_OFFER.args: crime = scene category, code = call priority

CALL_ALL_UNITS.hook: callouts announce: a priority 1 call no unit could be offered

PURSUIT_START.hook: POL.on('chase.changed'): the first unit joined, 2 s later if the chase still runs
PURSUIT_START.args: crime = first wanted reason (maps.reasonCrime) or SUSPECT_ON_THE_RUN

PURSUIT_UPDATE.hook: radio_voice 5 s tick: a chase whose heading changed, 30 s cooldown

SWAT.hook: POL.on('wanted.changed') level reaches POLICE.VOICE.SWAT_LEVEL (the AI tank tier)

SUSPECT_ARRESTED.hook: POL.on('arrest.cuffed') of a chased / wanted suspect
